title: Logo Design in Tashkent: Prices from $900
description: Logo design in Tashkent built on research and strategy: concepts, revisions, final files for print and web. An individual logo from $900. Talk to OneBranding.
lead: OneBranding designs logos that grow out of your business and audience, not out of a template: a distinctive sign that works at any size and on every surface. An individual logo starts at $900, or it can be part of a branding package.
intro: A logo is the shortest form of your brand: the sign people see on a shop front, a package, an app icon or a social media profile, often before they read a word. To work there, it has to be simple enough to remember, distinctive in your category and clear on a large sign and a tiny browser icon alike. That is why we start with research into your market and competitors, not with sketches.

Every logo comes with the versions you will need: horizontal and vertical layouts, a compact sign, colour and one-colour variants. When you need more than the sign, the logo becomes the starting point of a brand identity, and a brand book sets down the rules for using both. Before launch, we also test our design solutions with a live audience of designers, so the sign works for the people it is meant for.

includes.title: What logo design includes
items: Brief and research into your market and competitors
Logo concepts built on one clear idea
Rounds of revisions on the chosen concept
Horizontal and vertical layouts and a compact sign
Checks at small sizes and on real applications
Basic usage rules: clear space, minimum size, backgrounds
Final files in vector, print and web formats, plus source files

steps.name: Brief and research
steps.text: We learn what your business does and for whom, and study how competitors present themselves.

steps.name: Idea
steps.text: We define what the sign has to say and find the idea it will be built on.

steps.name: Design
steps.text: We turn the idea into logo concepts and develop the strongest one into a finished sign.

steps.name: Refinement
steps.text: We refine the logo with your feedback in rounds of revisions; you approve it before we prepare the files.

steps.name: Hand-over
steps.text: You receive every version of the logo in vector, print and web formats, with the source files.

timeline.title: How long it takes
timeline.text: A logo designed as part of a focused identity usually takes 2 to 6 weeks together with the identity. For a logo on its own, we agree the timeline after the brief, before we start.

items.q: How much does logo design cost in Tashkent?
items.a: An individual logo starts at $900; the final price depends on the scope we agree after the brief. If you also need colours, typography and a brand book, a branding package from $1,900 covers the logo and the identity together.

It is simple, stands out in your category and stays recognisable at any size, in colour and in one colour. Above all, it says something true about your brand, which is why our work starts with research rather than with drawing.

items.q: Can you redesign our existing logo?
items.a: Yes. We look at what people already recognise in your logo, keep what still works and redraw what holds it back. Sometimes careful refinement is enough, sometimes the brand needs a new sign; we decide that with you after the research.
Every version of the logo in vector formats for print and signage, in web formats for your website and social media, plus the source files, so any designer, printer or sign maker can work with them.

items.q: Is a logo enough, or do I need a brand identity?
items.a: A logo is enough to sign your work. Once you produce packaging, print, a website or social media posts, you also need colours, typography and graphics that work with it. That is a brand identity, and a brand book keeps it consistent.

cta.title: Start with a brief
cta.text: Tell us about your business and we will come back with a proposal for your logo: scope, timeline and price.
